topics.title: Bob Bowie Phone Jeopardy Mishap
topics.summary: A telephone-based game show featuring categories like famous people and world geography experiences technical difficulties during gameplay, leading to contestant frustration and a failed attempt at winning the $5000 grand prize due to issues with phone connectivity and unclear instructions.

topics.title: Ear Jamming and Parental Concerns
topics.summary: A listener discusses his wife’s habit of inserting her tongue into people's ears while expressing frustration about children exposed to inappropriate content. The conversation includes concerns regarding parental irresponsibility and the influence of outside media, with callers discussing personal preferences and awkward situations.

topics.title: Jackson Family Secrets & Radio Ramblings
topics.summary: Howard discusses an unauthorized biography of Michael Jackson, detailing alleged physical abuse by his father and rumors surrounding sexual relationships with figures like Tatum O’Neill and Madonna. The conversation shifts to opinions on the jackson family history, including claims about a half-brother and accusations against Chuck Scarborough regarding his credibility and personal beliefs.”} 29 words

topics.title: Howard Debates Anchorman Prospects
topics.summary: During a meandering discussion, Howard and Chuck debate whether Howard should have pursued an anchoring career. They discuss Dr. Ketter’s warnings about New York's seismic vulnerability and local news profitability versus national broadcasting, alongside personal anecdotes regarding Howard’s writing process and a disastrous earthquake documentary attempt.

topics.title: Earthquake Predictions & Tunnel Repairs
topics.summary: During a broadcast, hosts discuss impending earthquakes in New York City, advocating West Coast-style preparations while criticizing government inaction regarding tunnel repairs. They promote a book predicting widespread devastation fueled by unreinforced masonry and suggest organized crime would capitalize on the chaos.

topics.title: Baker Discusses Nose Jobs & City Chaos
topics.summary: Howard discusses his friend Dr. Baker’s concerns about maintaining a public image, referencing cosmetic procedures and their impact on professional perception. He then expresses frustration with city planning issues like walkathons causing traffic congestion and bureaucratic obstacles in Manhattan.
